description: React component for rendering and managing a thread view in Mattermost, including fetching thread data, handling WebSocket updates, and rendering the thread UI.

classes.name: ThreadViewer
classes.description: React component class for displaying a thread viewer with thread data fetching, WebSocket integration, and UI rendering.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes thread read status and fetches app bindings when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Updates WebSocket active thread status when component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when props change, such as reconnecting WebSocket or changing selected thread.

methods.name: morePostsToFetch
methods.description: Determines if more posts are available to fetch in the thread.

methods.name: getReplyCount
methods.description: Returns the reply count for the selected post or user thread.

methods.name: fetchThread
methods.description: Fetches thread data if following a post.

methods.name: markThreadRead
methods.description: Marks the current thread as read, updating last viewed and read status.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes thread data, updates last update timestamp, and manages WebSocket active thread status.

methods.name: handleCardClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on a post card to select it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the thread viewer UI, including loading state and thread content.
